entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Secret society of mages on Arcavios using forbidden magic and seeking to destroy Strixhaven.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: University of magic the Oriq target.

entities.name: Mage Hunters
entities.description: Horrifying creatures from Galathul that sense magic.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Leader of the Oriq, who knew planeswalkers and the Multiverse and was killed by the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker disguised as Professor Onyx at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Planeswalker captured by the Oriq who helped them in a trade.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Distracted by Lukka during the attack.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: Place Extus Narr reached to find books for the ritual.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: Monster resurrected by the Oriq ritual that killed Narr.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Student who joined Onyx; twin of Rowan.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Student who joined Onyx; twin of Will.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven library an Oriq agent looted.

entities.name: Shattered
entities.description: Group of at least 28 pyromancers who left the Oriq and wear broken masks.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who took the Shattered under her wing.

events.summary: Liliana, as Professor Onyx, witnesses an Oriq agent looting the Biblioplex but the Faculty ignores her warnings.
events.quote: witnessed an Oriq agent looting the Biblioplex

events.summary: Lukka is captured and taken to Extus Narr, who proposes a trade.
events.quote: Lukka was captured and taken to the leader of the Oriq

events.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a Mage Hunter attack on Strixhaven.
events.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina

events.summary: Professors and the Founder Dragons defend Strixhaven but cannot stop Narr reaching the Hall of Oracles to start the Blood Avatar ritual.
events.quote: unable to prevent Extus Narr from reaching the Hall of Oracles

events.summary: The Blood Avatar kills Narr, and the Kenrith twins contain the monster.
events.quote: Narr was killed by the avatar

events.summary: By 4564 AR the Oriq are considered effectively gone.
events.quote: By 4564 AR , the Oriq were considered "effectively gone".

events.summary: The Shattered meet Chandra around 4565 AR, who offers them a second chance.

relations.quote: the leader of the Oriq, Extus Narr
Narr was killed by the avatar
who took them under her wing
